API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ResourcesIP Destination Group Z Resource Get Destination IP Group By ID
IP Destination Group Z Resource Get Destination IP Group By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ipDestinationGroups/:ipGroupId

Retrieves the destination IP group based on the specified source IP group ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ipGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

ID of the destination IP group.

Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

ID of the destination IP group.

name
string

Name of the destination IP group.

type
string

Type of the destination IP group.

Possible values: [DSTN_IP, DSTN_FQDN, DSTN_DOMAIN, DSTN_OTHER]

addresses
string[]

IP addresses or domain names included in the group.

description
string

Description of the group.

creatorContext
string

Indicates whether the IP group or IP pool is created in Cloud & Branch Connector (EC) or ZIA.

Possible values: [ZIA, EC]

ipCategories
string[]

Not applicable to Cloud & Branch Connector.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, OTHER_ADULT_MATERIAL, ADULT_THEMES, LINGERIE_BIKINI, NUDITY, PORNOGRAPHY, SEXUALITY, ADULT_SEX_EDUCATION, K_12_SEX_EDUCATION, SOCIAL_ADULT, OTHER_BUSINESS_AND_ECONOMY,
